title: Uma captura não mostra movimento; duas mostram
title_en: One capture shows no movement; two do

extraction.note: Entities and edges proposed by a Claude Code session against the published article ontology. No human has reviewed this extraction.

what_it_says: The speaker list for Startup Summit Lisbon 2026 has 70 names today, and the page's own stated count agrees with the count made over the frozen bytes. That is all that can be said. Reporting movement honestly needs two captures and two hashes; with one there is no difference, only a photograph. The article exists to say that rather than to write 'the list grew', which would rest on nothing.
